title: Reflected Proximal Dynamics for Accelerated High-Accuracy Log-Concave Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2610.16248v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study sampling from $\pi(x)\propto\mathrm{e}^{-V(x)}$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$, where $V$ is $\alpha$-strongly convex and $\beta$-smooth with condition number $\kappa=\beta/\alpha$. For this problem, the proximal sampler preserves the target exactly and recovers overdamped Langevin dynamics in the small-step limit, but its Gaussian resampling step discards directional information. Underdamped Langevin dynamics retains such information through momentum to accelerate exploration, motivating a proximal construction that combines target preservation with directional persistence. We introduce \textit{reflected proximal dynamics}, which combines proximal sampling with an exact reflection of the auxiliary variable, conditional kinetic motion, and controlled refreshment. translated_title: 用于加速高精度对数凹采样的反射近端动力学
translated_abstract: 我们研究在 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 上从 $\pi(x)\propto\mathrm{e}^{-V(x)}$ 中采样的这一问题，其中 $V$ 是 $\alpha$-强凸且 $\beta$-光滑的函数，条件数为 $\kappa=\beta/\alpha$。针对该问题，近端采样器能够精确保留目标分布，并在小步长极限下恢复过阻尼朗之万动力学，但其高斯重采样步骤会丢弃方向信息。欠阻尼朗之万动力学则通过动量保留这些方向信息以加速探索，这启发了一种同时具备目标分布保持性和方向持续性的近端构造方法。我们提出了“反射近端动力学”，它将近端采样与辅助变量的精确反射、条件性动能运动以及受控刷新相结合。我们开发了两种实现方式：通量重采样的欠阻尼半转折和持续动量的四分之一转折。从具有常数 $\chi^2$ 散度的暖启动出发，两种方法均能达到……
tldr: 提出反射近端动力学方法，通过将近端采样与辅助变量的精确反射及动量保持机制相结合，实现对数凹分布的加速高精度采样。
en_tdlr: Proposes reflected proximal dynamics, which combines proximal sampling with exact reflection of the auxiliary variable and momentum persistence, to achieve accelerated high-accuracy log-concave sampling.
